cc:Work.dc:title: f08_c4_initial
cc:Work.dc:description: The upper panel uses seconds and links the C1 open square to the C4 filled circle for each of 12 A5000 roots. The lower panel uses time ratios for 24 initial RTX roots in each of three direct comparisons. C1/B has an estimate of 1.008 and interval 0.994 to 1.022, crossing equal time; both C4 comparisons lie below one. Each initial study has two rounds and a separate control and interval; neither is pooled with the later RTX confirmation.
